package consumer

import (
	"errors"
	"testing"

	"example.test/consumer/graphs"
	di "github.com/cratis/fundamentals.go/dependencyinjection"
	"github.com/cratis/fundamentals.go/dependencyinjection/container"
)

type inventoryRegistrar struct{ bindings map[di.Key]di.Binding }

func (r *inventoryRegistrar) Register(b di.Binding) error {
	if r.bindings == nil {
		r.bindings = map[di.Key]di.Binding{}
	}
	r.bindings[b.Key()] = b
	return nil
}
func TestGeneratedDescriptorInventoryAndGraphFailures(t *testing.T) {
	capture := &inventoryRegistrar{}
	if err := RegisterServices(capture); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if len(capture.bindings) != 12 {
		t.Fatal("empty or incomplete generated registration inventory", len(capture.bindings))
	}
	wide := capture.bindings[di.KeyFor[*Wide]()]
	if deps := wide.Dependencies(); len(deps) != 1 || deps[0] != di.KeyFor[*Tick]() {
		t.Fatal("wide direct edges are not unique", deps)
	}
	for _, key := range []di.Key{di.KeyFor[IFoo](), di.KeyFor[ISingleton](), di.KeyFor[ITick]()} {
		if capture.bindings[key].Ownership() != di.Borrowed {
			t.Fatal("interface owns value", key)
		}
	}
	graph := &inventoryRegistrar{}
	if err := graphs.RegisterServices(graph); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		name string
		keys []di.Key
		want error
	}{
		{"missing", []di.Key{di.KeyFor[*graphs.Consumer]()}, di.ErrMissing},
		{"cycle", []di.Key{di.KeyFor[*graphs.A](), di.KeyFor[*graphs.B]()}, di.ErrCycle},
		{"scoped capture", []di.Key{di.KeyFor[*graphs.Captive](), di.KeyFor[*graphs.Scoped]()}, di.ErrCaptiveLifetime},
	} {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			var registry container.Registry
			for _, key := range tc.keys {
				if err := registry.Register(graph.bindings[key]); err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
			}
			if _, err := registry.Build(); !errors.Is(err, tc.want) {
				t.Fatal("Build lost graph failure", err)
			}
			if graphs.Calls != 0 {
				t.Fatal("invalid graph activated factories")
			}
		})
	}
}
